The dataset is generated through the following steps:

1. Split the document into sentences.
2. Enumerate all unused sentence pairs within a document and generate their normalized versions. Normalization could include steps such as lowercasing, removing punctuation, or stemming.
3. Calculate the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) from the normalized versions of the sentence pairs using the SuffixAutomaton library available at \url{https://github.com/laohur/SuffixAutomaton}. A pair with a sufficiently long LCS is considered similar.
4. Sample the similar pairs into the dataset.
